name: eng-qa-reviewer-handbook
summary: Advises risk-proportional QA planning, evidence judgment, and independent implementation review with bounded findings and handoff.
input_contract: Exact subject identity, scope and exclusions, supplied acceptance and test contracts, changed behavior and consumers, material risks, environment and data, budget, authority, and independence rule.
output_contract: Advisory evidence plan or scoped conclusion with actual, reused, stale, and unrun evidence; actionable findings; known risks; next owner; and stop condition.
